newsitem.title: CANADA: Toronto Stock Exchange computer trading down - TSE.
newsitem.headline: Toronto Stock Exchange computer trading down - TSE.

text.p: The Toronto Stock Exchange computer trading shut down temporarily late in the session on Thursday.
TSE officials said they could not explain the problem but said they were working on fixing it.
The system difficulties coincided with a huge volume of shares in Bre-X Minerals Ltd which crossed when the stock re-opened at 1500 EST/2000 GMT.
An official said trading would resume at 1537 EST/2037 GMT.
